# artcraft-api

> Current documentation index generated from the exact MkDocs navigation.
> Capability and content-use claims are operator-scoped and provenance-bound.

## Home

- [Home](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/) — ArtCraft API + MCP Server using the connector SDK — a typed, action-routed connector.

## Overview

- [Overview](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/overview/) — > Category: Integration | Ecosystem Role: MCP Server > Built on agent-connector-sdk.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/architecture/) — The artcraft-api package owns external-system operations and source mappings. The shared connector SDK owns reusable runtime contracts.

## Installation

- [Installation](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/installation/) — artcraft-api is a standard Python package and a prebuilt container image.

## Deployment

- [Deployment](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/deployment/) — This page covers running artcraft-api as long-lived servers.

## Usage (API / CLI / MCP)

- [Usage (API / CLI / MCP)](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/usage/) — The current backend connector has three tools and eight source-reviewed actions. See README for the exact allowlist and configuration. All operation inputs and outputs are generated from the reviewed subset in api-spec/artcraft.reviewed.openapi.json.

## Backing Platform (ArtCraft)

- [Backing Platform (ArtCraft)](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/platform/) — artcraft-api is a client of a backing service instance. This page provides a Docker recipe for deploying one locally as an operator-selected provider endpoint.

## Glossary

- [Glossary](https://knuckles-team.github.io/artcraft-api/glossary/) — The browser operator experience for working with agents and their runtime. Graph OS hosts it as a composed service.
